# CuriousDevs

> CuriousDevs builds OJAS, an intelligence system for Edge AI and Physical AI, and PARTH, the human-scale humanoid robot it is embodied in. Based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.

Physical AI is not a trained model. It is a closed loop between sensing, judgement and motion, with a model as one component inside it. OJAS is the intelligence: it perceives, holds a picture of the world, plans, decides what is allowed, and acts on edge hardware next to the machine. PARTH is the body.
